title: Optimize join projection row construction
constraints: Preserve join projection output order and schema
rationale: project_join_rows used iterator collect for every projected row after join execution. The projected width is already known, so explicit preallocation avoids per-row growth uncertainty and iterator collection overhead.
steps: Keep existing projection index resolution and projected schema construction
Replace per-row iterator collect with a preallocated projected row Vec
Run focused join projection regressions and cargo check
expected_impact: Reduces small allocation overhead in join result projection for queries that select a subset of joined columns.
